description: Structured product seed data extracted from the VINSAK products listing and linked product detail pages. Examples are illustrative demo content, not VINSAK customer case studies.

products.name: VINSAK USAR (Universal Slitter and Rewinder)
products.summary: Modular slitter-rewinder platform configurable with die-cutting, inspection, inkjet and digital cold-foiling modules.
products.description: Designed for high-resolution security printing and customizable finishing. The modular configuration can include slitter-rewinder, die-cutting, 100% inspection, inkjet and digital cold foiling. The product page states speeds up to 300 m/min and describes variable-data printing for barcodes, QR codes, numbering and other data.

specifications.web_width_options: 330 mm, 450 mm and 530 mm (USAR slitter configuration)
specifications.unwind_diameter: 700 mm standard; upgrade option up to 1000 mm
specifications.maximum_rewind_diameter: 1000 mm single rewind; 450 mm dual rewind
specifications.other: Servo-driven major components; electronic web guidance; optional inspection camera; configurable modules

applications: Flexible packaging and lami-tube film handling
products.example: A label converter produces a roll of serialized product labels. A variable-data job prints a unique QR code on each label, while an inspection camera checks print quality and the slitter-rewinder prepares finished rolls.
products.data_quality_note: Specifications vary by configuration; confirm the exact machine build with VINSAK.

products.name: VINSAK LABEL-DECORE
products.summary: Modular label embellishment system for raised effects, digital foiling, cast-and-cure effects and variable data.
products.description: The page describes embossing/raised glossy textures, spot varnish, digital foiling without dies, cast-and-cure effects and variable-data printing. In grayscale mode, the system can switch fluids from varnish to black inks to print barcodes, QR codes and serial numbers.

specifications.available_print_width: Multiples of 70 mm, up to 530 mm

products.example: A cosmetics brand uses a raised glossy logo and digital foil on its label, while a variable QR code links each finished pack to a product-information page.
products.data_quality_note: The source page describes LABEL-DECORE and gives the HB X 50i technical configuration; verify configuration options with VINSAK.

products.name: UNIVERSAL 520 | 680 | 850
products.summary: Combined offset and flexo sleeve rotary press for labels, flexible packaging, folding cartons and security/transactional documents.
products.description: The Rotatek product page describes interchangeable lightweight offset sleeves that simplify format changes. It highlights flexibility across substrates and lower pre-printing costs compared with flexo plates or rotogravure rollers.
products.example: A packaging printer runs different label formats for multiple customers and changes formats using interchangeable sleeves rather than replacing a full set of heavy cylinders.
products.data_quality_note: The source page is hosted by Rotatek and is linked from VINSAK's product listing. The listing names 520/680/850; the opened Rotatek page is the UNIVERSAL family page and does not confirm every model-specific dimension.

products.name: RK-250 Plus
products.summary: Variable-format rotary offset press designed for full-colour, security and commercial documents.
products.description: The product page describes a shaftless rotary offset press with quick format changes, 16-roller inking batteries, front-positioned inkwells, automatic zero positioning and remote-controlled longitudinal register.
products.example: A secure document printer produces multi-colour forms and numbered transactional documents using a rotary offset press configured for its required format.
products.data_quality_note: Rotatek page is the linked detailed product source.

products.name: PERFECT NT / RK-500
products.summary: Shaftless rotary press intended especially for medium and long print runs.
products.description: The product page highlights modular shaftless technology, automation, reduced material waste, reliable print and colour registration, rapid setup, auto-zero positioning and remote-controlled longitudinal register.
products.example: A ticketing and label-printing operation uses the press for longer production runs where repeatability, register accuracy and reduced setup waste matter.
products.data_quality_note: Rotatek page is the linked detailed product source.

products.name: BRAVA 450
products.summary: Combined wet-offset semi-rotary and rotary press with in-line finishing capabilities.
products.description: The page describes switching between semi-rotary and rotary systems. Semi-rotary format changes do not require tools or cylinder changes. It is positioned for medium and short print runs.
products.example: A label producer prints short and medium runs for different bottle sizes, using semi-rotary mode to change formats without changing cylinders.
products.data_quality_note: Rotatek page is the linked detailed product source.

products.name: SPEED-JET Monochrome 1200 I
products.summary: Industrial monochrome inkjet system for high-resolution variable data, barcodes and QR codes.
products.description: The page describes digital workflow, soft proofing, remote job setup, database integration, support for industrial and mailing barcodes including Intelligent Mail Code and Data Matrix, and variable graphics/text. It can integrate with VINSAK camera, matching and read/print systems.

specifications.print_width: 43 mm module; stitching up to 850 mm

products.example: A mailing house prints a unique Data Matrix or barcode on each document and uses matching/read-print equipment to associate printed pieces with the correct records.
products.data_quality_note: Important source mismatch: VINSAK's products listing labels this item SPEED-JET Monochrome 1200 I, and the opened detail page uses that heading, but its introductory sentence refers to a High Build System. Confirm the exact model/spec sheet before publishing.

products.name: VINSAK Security Software
products.summary: Software for generating intricate security-printing artwork and anti-counterfeit design features.
products.description: The page describes guilloches, border generation, relief generation, patterned relief, line modulation, micro-text/nano-text and hidden images in micro-text. It is positioned for security devices used on documents such as passports, certificates and banknotes.
products.example: A certificate issuer uses guilloche borders, micro-text and hidden line patterns as visual security features that are difficult to reproduce.
products.data_quality_note: Software feature description; no pricing or licensing details were shown in the extracted page content.

products.name: VINSAK VIS 720-i
products.summary: Modular 72 mm industrial piezo drop-on-demand inkjet printhead system for variable data and barcode printing.
products.description: The page describes scalable print width by adding modules, printing on offset/coated/gloss papers and films, and software support for digital workflow, soft proofing, remote job setup, standard industrial/mailing barcodes, variable graphics/data and integration with camera/matching/read-print systems.

specifications.speed: 120 m/min at 360 x 180 dpi; 80 m/min at 360 x 360 dpi; 60 m/min at 360 x 720 dpi
specifications.ink_types: Water-based, solvent-based or UV-curable depending on application

applications: Printing on paper and film substrates
products.example: A label converter prints unique serial numbers and QR codes across a web of labels, with the print width expanded using multiple modules.
products.data_quality_note: Speed depends on selected resolution mode.

products.name: VINSAK Roll Lifter VRL-S-200
products.summary: Portable roll lifter with core gripper for lifting, turning and transporting rolls up to 200 kg.
products.description: The product page describes a safety brake, 360-degree rotation, manual winch operation and a workflow for gripping, lifting, positioning and releasing rolls. It is intended to reduce manual labour and reduce damage to the top paper layer.
products.example: An operator uses the roll lifter to move a heavy label-stock roll from storage to a machine's unwind position without manually lifting the roll.
products.data_quality_note: The product detail page identifies the model as VRL-S-200.

products.name: VINSAK DigiJet 1000/2000
products.summary: Narrow-web system for high-speed variable-data printing, including QR codes, barcodes, text and numbers.
products.description: The page describes printing variable-data matrix codes, QR codes, barcodes, text and numbers for connected packaging. It mentions UV low-migration inks for food applications and water-based inkjet systems on special request.

specifications.rewind_details: Upper rewind roll max diameter 600 mm; lower rewind roll max diameter 800 mm

applications: Food-packaging print jobs subject to ink and application requirements
products.example: A food-packaging converter prints a unique QR code on each pack so a consumer can open product-specific information; production records can associate each printed code with a batch.
products.data_quality_note: The page's low-migration ink statements are not a blanket food-contact compliance certification. Confirm ink, substrate and regulatory suitability for the intended application.

products.name: VINSAK Inkjet System VIS TIJ
products.summary: HP Thermal Inkjet-based variable-data printing system for text, numeric data, 1D and 2D barcodes.
products.description: The page describes multi-printhead stitching, support for water-based, invisible and fluorescent inks, printing up to 600 x 600 dpi, USB/Ethernet/Wi-Fi job transfer, bulk ink option, porous and non-porous substrates and password protection.

specifications.printhead_width_options: 0.5 inch (12.7 mm), 1 inch (25.4 mm), 2 inch (50.8 mm)
specifications.ink_types: Water-based, invisible, fluorescent and other HP-certified inks

applications: Printing on porous and non-porous materials
products.example: A packaging line prints a batch number, expiry date and QR code onto cartons using a TIJ printhead integrated with the line controller.
products.data_quality_note: The page does not state a maximum line speed in the extracted technical table.

products.name: VINSAK Inkjet System VIS 1200
products.summary: Modular wide-format piezo drop-on-demand inkjet system for printing on multiple paper substrates.
products.description: The page describes a modular printhead system, graphical user interface, automated head mounting and cleaning, replaceable print modules and integration with an online RIP. It mentions offset, coated and gloss papers.

specifications.print_width: 108 mm modules; system width up to 540 mm

products.example: A print service provider configures multiple 108 mm modules to cover a wider web and prints variable information across a production run.
products.data_quality_note: The product page includes differing speed ranges for water-based and UV systems; select values based on the actual ink configuration.

products.name: VINSAK NPM 480/570/630
products.summary: Automatic numbering and perforating machine for sheet-fed applications.
products.description: The page lists lateral and vertical perforation, resin-plate numbering, up to 8,000 sheets/hour, optional LCD computer control, oil-free vacuum pump technology, sheet detection and safety features.
products.example: A forms printer numbers and perforates printed sheets before they are separated into individual forms or tickets.
products.data_quality_note: The source table's minimum-paper-size row is poorly formatted; do not infer model-specific minimum sizes from the extracted text.
